correctness.rationale: Three cases characterize every possible acyclic edge configuration on K_{3,n}. Exact weighted counts give partition function Z=A^{n-2} Zstar, one-edge inclusion E/(AZstar), and Q_s/(A^2 Zstar) for all three pair orbits. A direct bivariate integer polynomial identity factors every squared-marginal-minus-joint numerator as strictly positive powers times an explicitly coefficientwise positive P_s. No asymptotic or partial enumeration is used for the universal quantifiers. The included independent pure-stdlib polynomial check and 60 weighted forest enumeration checks corroborate the algebra.

value.rationale: Negative correlation for the arboreal gas is a motivated unsolved general graph problem; the latest general complete-bipartite result covers only uniform forests. Extending to every positive common fugacity on an infinite family K_{3,n} (n>=5) is a nontrivial continuous-parameter dependence theorem, beyond the finite K_{3,4} graphical example. The structural three-pattern classification and exact positive-polynomial certificates are reusable, not an arbitrary numerically selected graph size.
